Lemma
[A functional identity] ↗ thm:hopf-lax-formula-derivation 1. ch3:3.3-lem-1\group Hamilton-Jacobi Equations

For $0\le s<t$, \[ u(x,t)=\min _y\left\{ (t-s)L\left(\frac{x-y}{t-s}\right)+u(y,s)\right\} . \]

Proof

\sketch Substitute the Hopf–Lax representation of $u(y,s)$ and use convexity of $L$ to combine the two action segments. The reverse inequality uses a minimizing point $w$ at time $t$ and the intermediate point on the affine segment from $w$ to $x$.

□
